sell.faq1Question: Does it cost anything to join?
sell.faq1Answer: No. Registration is free and there’s no monthly fee. Tallaby takes a commission on completed sales only (10% by default).
sell.faq2Question: How much do Tallaby’s services cost?
sell.faq2Answer: It depends on your products and order volume, so we agree on prices with you after you register. Nothing is charged during signup.
sell.faq3Question: Can I handle some services myself?
sell.faq3Answer: Yes. You choose for each service separately. For example, you can keep your stock and let Tallaby deliver your orders.
sell.faq4Question: How do my products get to Tallaby?
sell.faq4Answer: If Tallaby stores your products, you deliver your inventory to our warehouse. Our team shares the details when we confirm your setup.
sell.faq5Question: Can I change my setup later?
sell.faq5Answer: Yes. Contact our team and we’ll update it with you. Orders already in progress aren’t affected.
sell.faq6Answer: Earnings from delivered orders are added to your seller wallet and paid out to your bank account on Tallaby’s payout schedule.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Tallaby
faq.description: Answers about ordering, delivery times and fees, the {days}-day return window, refunds and payment on Tallaby.
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Find quick answers about shopping, delivery, returns and more.

items.question: What is Tallaby?
items.answer: Tallaby is an Egypt-first online marketplace where you can shop products from many independent sellers in one place, across many categories.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Add products to your cart, go to checkout, choose a delivery address and payment method, then confirm your order.

items.question: Can I pay cash on delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Cash on delivery is available on eligible orders, alongside mobile wallet, InstaPay and card payment.

items.question: Where does Tallaby deliver?
items.answer: Tallaby delivers across Egyptian governorates — Cairo, Giza and Alexandria, the Delta and Canal governorates, Upper Egypt, Sinai, Matrouh and the New Valley. Available areas are confirmed at checkout based on your address.

items.question: Is there free delivery?
items.answer: Delivery fees are calculated at checkout from your governorate and the weight of your order. Some sellers offer free delivery on individual products, and we run free-delivery offers from time to time — when one applies, you'll see it at checkout.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Cairo and Giza typically take {metro} business days, and other governorates typically {other} business days. These are estimates, not guaranteed dates — actual time may vary with the seller's location, your governorate and public holidays.

items.question: How much does delivery cost?
items.answer: The fee depends on your delivery governorate and the weight of the products in your order. It's calculated automatically at checkout, so you always see the exact amount before you confirm.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: Sign in and go to My Orders to see your order status, or use the order confirmation link sent after checkout.

items.question: How do I return a product?
items.answer: Every order can be cancelled or returned within {days} days of purchase. Request it through our website: from My Orders, open the order and start a cancellation or return. You'll get a return (RMA) number to track it.

items.question: Is cancelling or returning free?
items.answer: Yes — all cancellations and returns within {days} days of purchase are free of charge. Delivery fees do apply on cancelled or returned orders, so the delivery fee you paid is not refunded.

items.question: How will I get my refund?
items.answer: Refunds are made through the same payment method you used for the purchase, and processed within seven days of us receiving your cancellation request or the returned product. When the amount appears in a card holder's balance varies with the card issuer's policy.

items.question: How do I contact Tallaby?
items.answer: Email us at tallabycommerce@gmail.com or message us on WhatsApp — see our Contact page for details.

items.question: Can I shop from multiple sellers in one order?
items.answer: Yes. Tallaby is a multi-vendor marketplace, so your cart can include products from different sellers. Items are grouped by seller at checkout and may arrive in separate deliveries, sometimes on different days.

items.question: How do I become a seller on Tallaby?
items.answer: Visit our Sell on Tallaby page to learn about requirements, pricing and how to register your store.

items.question: How do I use a coupon code?
items.answer: Enter your coupon code at checkout before placing your order. Eligible discounts are applied automatically once validated.

items.question: What payment methods are available?
items.answer: Cash on delivery, mobile wallet, InstaPay, and card payment via Paymob.

items.question: Is online card payment available?
items.answer: Yes, you can pay securely by card at checkout using Paymob.

items.question: How do I change my language?
items.answer: Use the language switcher in the header to switch between Arabic and English at any time.

items.question: Do I need an account to order?
items.answer: No — you can check out as a guest. Creating an account lets you save addresses, track orders and view your order history across devices.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions | Tallaby
terms.description: The terms and conditions for using the Tallaby marketplace as a shopper or seller.
terms.heading: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of Tallaby and the purchase of products from sellers on our marketplace. By using Tallaby, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: 1. Using Tallaby
sections.body: You may browse and shop on Tallaby as a guest or with an account. You agree to provide accurate information and to use the marketplace only for lawful purposes.

sections.title: 2. Accounts
sections.body: When you create an account, you're responsible for keeping your login details secure and for activity on your account. Notify us if you suspect unauthorized use.

sections.title: 3. The Marketplace Model
sections.body: Tallaby is a marketplace: products are listed and sold by independent sellers, not by Tallaby itself. Each seller is responsible for the accuracy of their listings, the quality of their products, and fulfilling orders.

sections.title: 4. Orders & Pricing
sections.body: Prices are shown in Egyptian pounds (EGP) and are set by sellers. Placing an order is an offer to purchase, which is confirmed once accepted. Product availability and pricing may change before an order is confirmed.

sections.title: 5. Payment
sections.body: Tallaby supports cash on delivery, mobile wallet, InstaPay and card payment via Paymob. Card payments are processed securely by Paymob; Tallaby does not store your card details.

sections.title: 6. Shipping & Delivery
sections.body: Delivery is available across Egyptian governorates. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your governorate and order weight. Delivery dates are determined by the delivery mode chosen when you place your order and are estimates that may vary with shipping companies' backlog. See our Shipping page for details.

sections.title: 7. Returns & Refunds
sections.body: All orders can be cancelled or returned within 14 days of purchase. Cancellations and returns are requested through our website and are free of charge within that period, but delivery fees apply on cancelled or returned orders and are not refunded. Refunds go back through the same payment method used for the purchase and are processed within seven days of receiving the cancellation request or the returned product; when the amount appears in a card holder's balance depends on the card issuer's policy. See our Returns & Refunds page for the full process.

sections.title: 8. Prohibited Use
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the marketplace, including submitting false information, attempting to bypass security, or using Tallaby for any unlawful purpose.

sections.title: 9. Intellectual Property
sections.body: Tallaby's branding, design and platform content belong to Tallaby. Product content (images, descriptions) belongs to the respective sellers or their licensors.

sections.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Tallaby facilitates transactions between shoppers and sellers but is not the manufacturer or seller of record for marketplace products. To the extent permitted by law, Tallaby is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the marketplace.

sections.title: 11. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of Tallaby after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.

sections.title: 12. Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

returns.heading: Returns & Refunds
returns.intro: Received the wrong item, or changed your mind? Here's how returns work on Tallaby.
returns.windowBody: All orders can be cancelled or returned within {days} days of purchase. Items need to come back in the condition you received them, with their original packaging and any included accessories. Some products can't be returned for hygiene or safety reasons — where that applies, it's noted on the product page.
returns.howToBody: Cancellations and returns are requested through our website. Sign in to your account, go to My Orders, open the order and select the item you want to cancel or return. You'll get a return (RMA) number to track your request.
returns.reasonsIntro: You can request a return for reasons including:
returns.costFreeBody: All cancellations and returns within {days} days of purchase are free of charge.
returns.costPaidBody: Delivery fees apply on cancelled or returned orders — the delivery fee you paid on the original order is not refunded.
returns.refundBody: The value of a cancelled or returned order is refunded through the same payment method you used for the purchase. Your refund is processed within seven days of us receiving your cancellation request or the returned product.
returns.refundMethod1: Refunds always go back the way you paid — you don't need to pick a refund method
returns.refundMethod2: When the amount appears in a card holder's balance varies according to the card issuer's policy
returns.refundMethod3: Delivery dates depend on the delivery mode you choose when placing your order, and are estimates that may vary with shipping companies' backlog

faqs.question: How much do I earn?
faqs.answer: You earn 10% of the eligible order amount, excluding shipping, when an order using your code is successfully delivered.

faqs.question: How much does my customer save?
faqs.answer: Customers receive 10% off their eligible order when they use your promo code at checkout.

faqs.question: Can my code be used more than once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your promo code is reusable and can be used on multiple orders.

faqs.question: When do I receive my commission?
faqs.answer: Your commission becomes available after the order reaches Delivered status.

faqs.question: What happens if an order is cancelled or returned?
faqs.answer: Cancelled or returned orders do not generate valid affiliate earnings. If a credited order is later refunded or returned, the corresponding commission may be reversed.

faqs.question: Can I see which orders used my code?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your Affiliate section shows referred orders, statuses, and earnings for completed deliveries.

faqs.question: Can I see the customer's personal information?
faqs.answer: No. Affiliate order information is limited to what is necessary to track your referral and earnings while protecting customer privacy.
